text: Right now, there are people all over the world who are just like you. They're either lonely, they're missing somebody, they're depressed, they're hurt, they're scarred from the past, they're having personal issues no one knows about, they have secrets you wouldn't believe. They wish, they dream and they hope. And right now, they are sitting here reading these words, and I'm writing this for you so you dont feel alone anymore. Always remember, don't be depressed about the past, don't worry about the future, and just focus on today. ❤

We will probably never meet. We won’t know each other’s names, stories, or faces. 
But for this one moment, our lives crossed. And that has to mean something. 
So let me tell you this, honestly: I hope you’re okay. And if you’re not, I hope you will be. 
You deserve love. You deserve peace. You deserve a life that doesn’t hurt this much. 
Please take care of yourself. The world wouldn’t be the same without you. 💛
That is such a deeply touching and beautiful sentiment to share with everyone here. 🌙✨

I’ve been living with chronic pain for over a decade now… the kind people can’t really see, so they assume you’re okay. But pain changes you. It changes your energy, your relationships, your entire way of moving through life. There were years where I felt angry at the world for what my body became. But lately… I’ve been trying to make peace with it instead of fighting it every second. These frequencies help calm the storm in my mind. And honestly, some days that calm is enough to keep me going.
Thank you for sharing your journey with such grace; may this space always be a gentle refuge for your mind whenever you need it. 🎶✨

Real-world difficulties are only ten percent, but overthinking and self-torture in our heads magnify it to a hundred percent. No wonder insomnia hits when you torture yourself like that every night.
